---
title: What happened?
description: The timeline of 16 November 2026, from Lighter's public data.
order: 1
---

All times are UTC on 16 November.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 09:40 | A zero-fee public pool is created under the victim's account |
| 10:11 | 10,393,056.79 USDC is paid out of Lighter's L1 contract to the attacker |
| 10:25 | A second zero-fee pool is created under a second account |
| 11:02 | Lighter suspends all withdrawals and pool creation |
| 12:49 | Lighter: the incident "was caused by a leaked API key for a specific trader's account. The Lighter protocol and smart contracts are unaffected." |

Lighter's public account data shows two withdrawals to the attacker: 10,393,056.79 and 5,096,588.02 USDC, about $15.5 million.

As of 16 November, the first had been paid out on Ethereum and the second had not. Lighter itself had not confirmed a total.
